stem:
A bag is marked $\mathrm{Rs}\,800$. Sana gets a $10\%$ discount on the marked price.

Which claim is correct?

options.text: The discount amount can be found with no reference to the marked price $\mathrm{Rs}\,800$.
The same $10\%$ discount settles every other tag in the shop with no further base.
Discount $=10\%$ of $800=\mathrm{Rs}\,80$, so the selling price is $\mathrm{Rs}\,720$.
Read the digit $8$ in $800$ alone to decide the discount.

teacher.key_rationale: A discount is a percentage of the marked price: 10% of 800 is 80, so selling price is 720. Omitting the marked base, widening to every tag, or reading a single digit all miss that hinge.
